label: GO step after an unrewarded visit to S1
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), and about 97% of mass is on GO steps whose previous trial was unrewarded; it is essentially silent after rewarded trials. Among those, it is selective for the previous reached state being S1: unrewarded common a1->S1 is near-deterministic (precision 0.98, ~61% of mass), unrewarded rare a2->S1 fires ~44% of the time (more when the trial before was also unrewarded), and unrewarded S2 visits almost never fire (precision ~0.05). Dev: precision 0.67, recall 0.68, F1 0.67, mass recall 0.79. Much of the missed mass (~16%) is on the window first trial, where prev_state is outside the window and cannot be checked; GO & unrewarded & prev_state != 2 gets mass recall 0.95 at precision 0.56. Magnitude is larger late in the episode (ep_trial 70-99) and at low value; it does not track the hidden good state or the upcoming choice. Uses only observed variables.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a1 S1 u, a2 S1 u, ?) and trial before (GO: a1 S1 u, a2 S2 u, a2 S1 u); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO, phase=GO & ep_dec=8, phase=GO & ep_dec=9.
